issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a Lecture constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, but the template's Lecture constructor only accepts three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). The solution implements the five-parameter constructor. This mismatch in the template constructor signature will confuse students about the expected constructor parameters and prevents them from following the UML/specification directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Lecture constructor to match the specification and solution: add parameters for numberOfLecturers and numberOfTutors (in the same order as the UML) and implement assignments to the corresponding attributes. Also add the five private attributes in the template (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) so students can implement the getters/setters and other methods according to the UML.
